cat > /home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-openclawlearner-1790687902/attempts/7fdda7e58310495d82461b54840148e2/system/state/workspace/programs/task-fb2d9053.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    """Extend each vertical 5-marker column upward, carrying encountered colors."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h = len(grid)
    if not h:
        return out
    for c, marker in enumerate(grid[-1]):
        if marker != 5:
            continue
        color = 5
        for r in range(h - 2, -1, -1):
            if grid[r][c] != 0:
                color = grid[r][c]
            else:
                out[r][c] = color
    return out
PY
